oneOf.description: year strategy: disjoint explicit calendar-year lists per split

year_random strategy: pooled train+val calendar years + a disjoint test year range; the pooled rows are split into train/val by a seeded fraction (row level). No train block — train is the random remainder.

obs_vars.description: Source columns or derived names (wind_east/wind_north, computed by TCDataset from wind_speed + wind_from_direction).

station_selection.description: How to pick max_stations when a sample has more candidates: 'nearest' (default, deterministic) or 'random' (train-only view augmentation; val/test always nearest). Only bites when n_available > max_stations.

cache_sorted_obs.description: On a slow .npz load, build (and reuse) a sibling <stem>_sorted/ memory-mappable cache so future runs start in seconds. Default true.

eval_geo_maps.description: End-of-train test pass: draw the per-class spatial prediction maps (test/spatial_pred/*) on a cartopy basemap with coastlines/borders (requires cartopy). Default false = plain lat/lon scatter, no basemap.

num_workers.description: TRAIN loader (random mode): worker processes for CPU sample assembly. 0 (default) = synchronous, identical batches. >0 spreads the epoch's steps across processes (training is input-bound); tune to ~CPU cores. fork on Linux (cheap), spawn elsewhere. Eval stays single-process.

prefetch_factor.description: Prefetch queue capacity per worker (num_workers>0): queue holds num_workers*prefetch_factor batches before workers block. Default 2.

tc_fraction.description: Fraction of each batch drawn as TC samples (rest = background). A single number applies to all splits, or a {train, val, test} object sets it per split (e.g. balanced 0.5 val/test for honest metrics while train sits lower). A split absent from the object defaults to 0.5.

background_sampling.description: How background (no-storm) samples are selected. 'time' (default): the pool excludes any synoptic timestamp within background_buffer_hours of ANY active TC basin-wide (shrinks sharply in peak season). 'spatial': every grid timestamp is kept and each draw is background iff no storm is within background_exclusion_radius_km of the point at ±background_buffer_hours.

background_exclusion_radius_km.description: Spatial mode only: a background draw is rejected if a storm is within this radius of the point at the draw time. null/omit → radius_km (a storm within the station-collection radius would put storm-affected stations in the sample).

class_weight_scheme.description: If not 'none', per-class loss weights are computed at setup from the train split's class counts and injected as loss_kwargs.class_weights (stored back in the manifest). An explicit trainer.loss_kwargs.class_weights overrides this.

class_weight_beta.description: Effective-number hyperparameter (class_weight_scheme=effective_number only); near 1, e.g. 0.99/0.999/0.9999. Higher = wider spread between common and rare classes.

class_weight_normalize.description: Scale the present-class weights to mean 1.0 (default true). Cosmetic for training — cross_entropy_loss reduces by the weight sum, so this only rescales the printed/manifest weight vector, not the gradient. Set false to record the raw scheme values (e.g. raw Cui effective-number weights).

n_background.description: Effective class-0 (background) sample count folded into class weighting. Background is synthesised (no fixed count), so this is a hyperparameter. null/omit → default to the realized per-epoch sampling count (steps_per_epoch x bg_half).

target.description: Prediction target, resolved against data/targets.TARGET_SCHEMA. Drives label, head size, default loss, metrics, and class names. Currently only nominal targets are wired; 'organisation' is the default 9-class ordinal scale.

obs_bounds.description: Per-variable [min, max] for minmax or [mean, std] for standardise. Keys must match obs_vars as listed (derived names included); use signed symmetric bounds for wind components.

missingness_indicator.description: True (default) = concatenate obs_mask as its own channel in the shared token-projection input, so a missing feature (filled with 0) is distinguishable from a real observation equal to 0. False drops the mask channel (missing == observed-zero).

embed_dim.description: Latent + token width D (divisible by num_heads).

num_latents.description: N — number of learned latent vectors (index dim the model processes).

num_process_layers.description: L — latent self-attention blocks in the Processor.

processor_weight_sharing.description: True = one Processor block applied num_process_layers times (recurrent / cross-layer weight tying; fewer params). Default false = independent blocks.

decode_mode.description: Decoder track: single-query attention (default) or mean+project.

seed.description: Single seed for Trainer (model init, dropout) and TCLoader (shuffle).

gpu.description: GPU index to pin training to (sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES before JAX inits). On multi-GPU boxes this stops JAX claiming + preallocating every device. --gpu overrides; a shell CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES wins.

loss_key.description: Which metric is the training loss / differentiated. Defaults to the first metric ('loss', resolved from trainer.loss).

loss.description: Name of a registered loss from training/losses.py LOSSES ('cross_entropy' default, 'coral'). Used as the training objective and the 'loss' metric.

loss_kwargs.description: Forwarded to the loss factory. cross_entropy composes focal_gamma, class_weights, and emd_lambda/emd_omega/emd_mu (squared-EMD regulariser). coral takes n_classes + optional task_weights. An explicit class_weights here overrides data.class_weight_scheme.

metrics.description: Per-batch metrics to report, selected by name from the METRICS registry (training/metrics.py). Only 'loss' is reported unconditionally; omit this key for the default [binary_accuracy, mae_class]. List 'cross_entropy' to keep the unweighted comparability anchor (and if patience_metric uses it).

steps_per_epoch.description: Random TC-sampling mode: gradient steps per epoch. Omit/null = sequential mode (one pass over TC data). Read by train.py/tune.py.

run_dir.description: Root directory for all run artifacts (checkpoints + logs). Takes precedence over checkpoint_dir.

attn_log_every_n_steps.description: Step cadence for val/attn_entropy; defaults to log_every_n_steps.

attn_fig_every_n_epochs.description: Epoch cadence for val/attn_map + val/attn_grid figures; 0 = disabled.

eval_plots_every_n_epochs.description: Epoch cadence for val confusion matrix / per-class F1; 0 = disabled.

grad_hist_every_n_epochs.description: Epoch cadence for grad_flow/* histograms (TRAIN probe, also at init); 0 = disabled.

diagnostics.description: Log the diagnostics/* figure row (weight/gradient/activation distributions) at init and on the best params after training.

diagnostics_loss_landscape_grid.description: Grid size for the end-of-training loss-landscape figure (grid² forward passes). 0 = skip (the one expensive diagnostic).

profile.description: Trace the first profile_steps training steps with the JAX profiler to <log_dir>/profile (view with TensorBoard's Profile plugin).
